published.source: Regear and rotation round (branch claude/keen-brown-o2g32n-hunter, 2026-10-23): the 8% hit cap gear, re-searched talents and rotations, race sweep (was 1094.1)

summary: Marksmanship with Lone Wolf (+20% damage with no pet out). It beats a cat because a Forever pet takes no player buffs.
rotation: Pre-pull: Aspect of the Hawk at -3s, walk to 12 yd, Rapid Fire at -0.1s
Rapid Fire, racials, potions and Demonic Rune on cooldown
Arcane Shot on cooldown (above Aimed Shot, no mana floor)
Aimed Shot on the cooldown it shares with Multi-Shot (mana >= 40%)
Serpent Sting when it is down (after Aimed Shot)
Sniper Shot on cooldown while mana >= 10 x seconds left
Melee weave: between Auto Shots, walk in for a main hand swing with Raptor Strike queued when the next Auto Shot waits 1.2s or less and the shot cooldowns stay down, while mana >= 25 x seconds left
caveats: Assumed: Trueshot Aura's top rank gives 100 ranged attack power (the client has 50). Hunter's Mark gives 143, the server hotfix (the client has 71).
Aspect of the Hawk stays at rank 5 (90 RAP). Forever's rank 6 gives only 55.
Arcane Shot takes 10% of ranged attack power and Serpent Sting 3% a tick (beta log fit: 11% and 3.5%).
Auto Shot fires through casts and winds up 0.5s, which moving cancels.
Wildstalker Armor 4-piece and 5-piece aren't active. They would add 17.
Rapid Killing never triggers on a single boss.
Assumed: 22% more crit per Agility than Classic.
A 2.5s bow at Rhok'delar's 44.0 DPS. A 2.6s gun sims 0.3 to 1.0 higher with a 15% ammo pouch, 3.4 to 5.2 lower with Era's 14% pouch.
notes: Request written by mksettings (spec hunter_lw, the hunter_presets.sh rotation); it matches the shipped preset's gear, talents, APL, race, consumes, raid buffs, debuffs and professions. Pet set to none (petType omitted = PetNone).
